name: Field Atlas
supersedes: cb.tokens.v2.json (kept on disk as history; never mutated)
scope: [data-cb-v3] on the Coursebook route root. v2 tokens stay bound to v2 surfaces until CP-025b migrates them.
note: Visual contract v3. A lit paper world with physical objects: parchment ground, deep forest rail, card stock, one terracotta primary, wood-only props. Every value here is measurable; no surface may paint a raw colour outside this table. Labels never sit on wood, gold or sage.

source_measurements.method: dominant-colour sampling of docs/concept-parity/refs/*.png (Pillow, 160px resample) plus the reference measurements in docs/concept-parity/PLAN.md section 2
source_measurements.cta_decision: The concept CTA #db6c45 carries ink at 5.31:1 but separates from parchment at only 2.68:1. v3 ships the deepened fill #b4532f with a warm cream label at 4.79:1 (pure white reaches the 4.98:1 quoted in PLAN.md) and a 3.96:1 fill edge against parchment. Both options are rendered on parchment in docs/coursebook-visual-identity-v3/cta-choice.png for the reviewer.

role_rules.canvas: the route ground: parchment. One per surface, never a card fill.
role_rules.canvas-edge: the darkest edge of the parchment vignette; never a fill or a text background except inside the vignette field.
role_rules.card-stock: paper card and sheet fill; sits on canvas with elev-1 or a 1px rule, never both a shadow and a thick border.
role_rules.ink: reading text and iconography on paper. AAA body text.
role_rules.ink-soft: secondary text, captions and metadata. Never below 4.5:1.
role_rules.rule: hairlines, dividers, card borders and the 1px outline of a quiet pill. Non-text only.
role_rules.forest: the rail and the top band ground. Filled field, never text on paper.
role_rules.on-forest: labels and glyphs on the forest rail.
role_rules.terracotta: the single primary action fill per surface. Never a text colour.
role_rules.on-terracotta: the label on the primary action.
role_rules.terracotta-quiet: a quiet warm field for a selected row, a tag blank or a soft aside panel; carries ink text.
role_rules.gold: a mark: medallion rim, completion seal, Game-mode XP chip border. Never a text background.
role_rules.sage: a quiet evidence fill: recorded-check tally, progress ground. Never a text background.
role_rules.wood: the shelf plank and the evidence tray only. A physical object, never a text background, never a page or card fill.
role_rules.wood-edge: the front lip and grain edge of a wood object; defines its thickness against wood.
role_rules.plum: Parent Studio identity, and only that. Text-safe on canvas.
role_rules.alert: error and destructive state text and icon. Never decoration.
role_rules.focus: the focus ring only. A functional state, never a fill or a text colour.

surfaces.name: Global Home (`home.global`)
surfaces.note: one primary pill; wood only on the shelf plank; the plank's lip is wood-edge; fox and tag are DOM-labelled

surfaces.name: Discover / Workshop
surfaces.note: covers are media, not tokens; trust labels sit on card stock

surfaces.name: Classroom
surfaces.note: one primary = choose the check answer; XP chip only in Game mode

surfaces.name: Course home
surfaces.note: nodes are DOM buttons on a plate; the plate never carries labels

surfaces.name: Parent Studio
surfaces.note: plum only here; no game chrome; no terracotta primary competing with the learner's course

surfaces.name: Evidence tray / print sheet
surfaces.note: print and take-home stay paper: no forest rail, no primary fill; alert is text plus a sentence for a refused export or an unrecorded observation, never a fill

surfaces.name: Component lab
surfaces.note: a labelled preview of every primitive and state; never presented as a live screen

surface_rules: A surface may use a subset of the roles in its allowed list and may never use a role that is not in it.
Every route surface allows alert, because EXPERIENCE-QUALITY-BAR Q7 requires an error and offline state on every screen; alert is always a text state with a sentence, never a fill.
The evidence tray and print sheet are not routes but they are not exempt from alert: a refused export or an unrecorded observation reports on the sheet in alert text.
A wood object's lip is wood-edge everywhere wood is allowed; wood without wood-edge has no thickness.
The component lab allows every role because it must be able to show every state; it is never shipped as a screen.
plum is Parent Studio only; forest is never a fill on the evidence sheet or on Parent Studio.
text_placement_rule: These six roles are the only text colours in v3. A text role paints only on the grounds listed for it, and every listed pair carries a text gate below at or above 4.5:1. A surface may therefore permit a text role only if at least one of its grounds is gated for that role.
night_atlas_note: Dark mode is the same world lit by one lamp, not an inverted theme. canvas is warm near-black, card-stock is a lifted paper brown, forest stays the rail, terracotta becomes a lit clay fill with an ink label. Gold and sage stay marks. Paper textures switch to their night tiles at a slightly higher opacity.

rules: Elevation is contact shadow for a physical object on paper, never a glow.
A card uses elev-1 or a 1px rule border, not both.
inset-1 is for pressed and recessed fields only (a tray, an input, a selected slot).
No elevation on text, rules, the rail or the canvas ground.

radius_rules: square: plates, scene frames, rules and table cells.
soft: inputs, chips and small controls.
pill: actions only (primary and quiet pills), never a card.

families.display: "CB Display", "Fraunces", ui-serif, Georgia, "Noto Serif JP", "Hiragino Mincho ProN", "Yu Mincho", serif
families.ui: "CB UI", "Source Sans 3", system-ui, "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", "Yu Gothic", "Noto Sans JP", sans-serif
families.cjk: "Noto Serif JP", "Hiragino Mincho ProN", "Yu Mincho", "Noto Serif CJK JP", serif

subsets.CB Display: Fraunces, OFL, subset to Latin plus punctuation
subsets.CB UI: Source Sans 3, OFL, subset to Latin plus punctuation
subsets.cjk: system CJK stack; a shipped Noto Serif JP subset is the first entry when CP-004 embeds it

type.loading: font-display: swap; a face that fails to load leaves the system fallback in place and never blanks the route

container.name: cb
container.measured_against: the route container, never the window
container.note: Every cqi in this table resolves against the [data-cb-v3] route container.

type.measure: 50-75ch for prose; display headings at most 20ch, section headings at most 34ch
rules: Body is 1rem so a 200 percent root scales every step.
Display is measured against the route container via cqi, so a narrow route shrinks the headline instead of overflowing it.
Japanese lesson lines use the cjk family for kana and kanji and the ui family for romaji; furigana is smaller than the body step by design, never a seventh authored size.
Grain and vignette are aria-hidden and pointer-events none; they sit above the canvas and below all content.
Grain opacity may never exceed opacity_ceiling over a text run.
Wood is a tile on the shelf plank and the evidence tray only; it never sits behind text.
Missing texture falls back to flat canvas; never a blank route, never a broken-image mark.
All tiles are seamless 3x3 (CP-011 proof) and at most 60 KB each.

motion.reduced_motion: transitions are removed, not shortened; the state change still happens on the next frame
rules: No duration in this table may exceed ceiling (600 ms).
No looping, pulsing, shimmering or infinite animation anywhere.
Motion is feedback for a real event: press, lift, route change, check verdict, completion.
transform and opacity only; never animate layout, colour or filter.

focus_ring.note: The ring is drawn outside the control on the ground it sits on, which is why the focus gates are measured against grounds, not against the fills the control itself paints.

never_text_on.wood: wood is a prop. Labels never sit on wood; a label that belongs to the shelf sits on the card or on the canvas beside the plank.
never_text_on.gold: gold is a rim and a seal. Any label near gold sits on canvas or card stock.
never_text_on.sage: sage is an evidence fill at 1.5:1 against paper. A label on sage would fail; the tally's label sits on canvas.

forbidden: rainbow or decorative gradients; the only gradient is the named vignette
raw hex outside the token table
a second identity hue on one screen
shadow on text, rules, the rail or the ground
stars, ratings, review counts, invented XP or invented counts
